file_stem: RWB E1 055 Proof of delivery capture design with WIN
title: Proof of delivery capture design with WIN
status_text: Ready. POD steps wait for RWB-ACE-001
goal: Send notices to WIN for registered mail and record sent and delivered dates, so timers start at delivery
why: A legal notice period runs from delivery, not from printing. WIN's proof of delivery is ingested by ACE and read back through v_ace_pod.
triggers: POD read daily 06:00 after WIN is COMPLETE

ace.note: WIN source COMPLETE before reading POD

stores: INT-14 outbound file over SFTP to WIN; INT-15 ingested by ACE (not by the Workbench); outbox; Quartz

path.text: INT-14 file over SFTP to WIN

rules: BR1: only dispatch-eligible notices (GENERATED in E1) are sent
BR2: the notice period starts from the delivery date
BR4: read v_ace_pod only when the WIN batch is COMPLETE
BR5: no barcode after 3 days -> REC-05 break
risks: No WIN acknowledgement -> resend; task after the 3rd failure (MSG-GEN-006)
WIN batch not COMPLETE or late -> stale (MSG-P1-001)
Unknown barcode or notice_ref -> row held on the exception list
example: WIN acknowledgement 26112026, barcode RR123456789TH, NPL -> Sent
